title: Non-kinship growth diversification rollout

held.reason: C-quality deep reporting stack remains research-only

rollout_rules: Use source stage index 1 from event-horse-dance, event-chase, event-call, and event-seed-sleep.
Report-simple families expose only wrapper_depth 0-5 from v0.87.1.
Reaction-simple families expose all wrapper_depth 0-4 from v0.89.
No existing narrative family is modified or removed.
Legacy quote-* first-wrapper diversity metric remains scoped to the original fixed quote lane; new report-simple-* families are tracked separately.
All new stages must remain strict palindromes and noun-collision free.
quality_rationale: Accepted report stages are A/B+/B only; all C stages remain held.
Reaction stages reuse the exact wrapper chain already accepted in reaction-light, with shorter and simpler source clauses.
The added families reduce semantic concentration without changing the underlying palindrome grammar.
success_criteria: No new noun collision or palindrome failure.
Legacy 18 fixed quote families and 18-way first-wrapper diversity remain unchanged.
